t: Why Diversity, Equity And Inclusion Are On the Way Up, Not Out
s: February 28, 2024 - In the 1980’s there was a push to make diversity a priority in all businesses. It was no longer just how many people from different backgrounds were being hired. It evolved to focusing on once they were hired, how much did they experience inclusion or exclusion.
